description.title: Rolling climate window for rule-based sowing

simcomponent.description: Short daily buffers of minimum temperature and rainfall shift back one day each step; from them the 7-day mean minimum temperature, the 3-day accumulated rainfall and the volumetric soil moisture of the top 5 cm layer are derived.

Sets DoSow on the first day inside the planting window [vSowWindowStartDOY .. vSowWindowStartDOY+vSowWindowLengthDays] on which any rule is met: 7-day mean minimum temperature le vSowTmin7Max, OR 3-day accumulated rainfall ge vSowRain3Sum, OR top-5cm volumetric moisture ge wilting point + vSowMoistFracAW*(FC-WP). Sowing never happens while a crop is already in the field. If no rule has fired by the last window day, sowing is forced on that day so no season is lost. HasSown latches after sowing and is released when the next window opens, so at most one sowing per window. vSowWindowStartDOY is supplied per grid cell by the project file.

var.rule: if(${CURRENT.DOY} == ${vSowWindowStartDOY}) { false } else { if(${SowingRule.DoSow} or ${SowingRule.HasSown}) { true } else { false } }

${SowingWindowClimate.Avg7Tmin} le ${vSowTmin7Max} or ${SowingWindowClimate.Rain3Sum} ge ${vSowRain3Sum} or ( not check:isNull(${SowingWindowClimate.MoistTop5}) and ${SowingWindowClimate.MoistTop5} ge (${SowingWindowClimate.WP5} + ${vSowMoistFracAW} * (${SowingWindowClimate.FC5} - ${SowingWindowClimate.WP5})) )

if( ${CURRENT.DOY} ge ${vSowWindowStartDOY} and ${CURRENT.DOY} le (${vSowWindowStartDOY} + ${vSowWindowLengthDays}) and not (${SowingRule.HasSown} or ${SowingRule.DoSow}) and not ${CropManagement.WithCrop} and ( ${SowingWindowClimate.Avg7Tmin} le ${vSowTmin7Max} or ${SowingWindowClimate.Rain3Sum} ge ${vSowRain3Sum} or ( not check:isNull(${SowingWindowClimate.MoistTop5}) and ${SowingWindowClimate.MoistTop5} ge (${SowingWindowClimate.WP5} + ${vSowMoistFracAW} * (${SowingWindowClimate.FC5} - ${SowingWindowClimate.WP5})) ) or (${vSowForceAtWindowEnd} == 1 and ${CURRENT.DOY} == (${vSowWindowStartDOY} + ${vSowWindowLengthDays})) ) ) { true } else { false }

if(${CURRENT.DOY} == ${vSowWindowStartDOY}) { 0 } else { if(${SowingRule.DoSow} and not ${SowingRule.RuleMet}) { 1 } else { if(check:isNull(${SowingRule.SeasonSowForced})) { 0 } else { ${SowingRule.SeasonSowForced} } } }
